description: Transaction time. Use this to build time-aware, leakage-safe features.
Merchant category (e.g. grocery, electronics, telecom_topup). May be missing.
Anonymous device/channel identifier used for the transaction.
Device/channel type (mobile_app, web, pos_terminal, atm, ussd). May be missing.
Coarse transaction location code. May be missing.
Payment method used (mobile_wallet, debit_card, credit_card, bank_transfer, qr_code).
Type of transaction (purchase, bill_payment, p2p_transfer, cash_withdrawal, topup).
Customer account age, in days, at the time of the transaction.
Target variable. Present in train.csv only. 1 = fraudulent transaction.
